<div class="root t-{{theme}}"><style>*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}
.root{position:relative;font-family:Inter,sans-serif;color:#fff;overflow:hidden;--spring:linear(0,.06 2.5%,.22 5.5%,.5 10.5%,.78 16.5%,.94 22%,1.03 28%,1.05 33%,1.04 39%,1.01 48%,.995 58%,1 70%,1);--bounce:linear(0,.25 8%,.7 16%,1 22%,.86 30%,.83 33%,.86 36%,1 44%,.96 50%,.95 52%,.96 54%,1 60%,.99 65%,1 72%,1);--out:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.x,.cam{position:absolute;inset:0}
.cam{transform-origin:50% 50%}
@keyframes leave{to{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-28px) scale(1.015);filter:blur(8px)}}
@keyframes push{from{transform:scale(1)}to{transform:scale(1.04)}}
@keyframes lift{from{transform:translate(var(--in-x,0px),var(--in-y,56px))}}
@keyframes clear{from{opacity:0;filter:blur(12px)}}
@keyframes fadein{from{opacity:0}}
@keyframes fadeout{to{opacity:0}}
@keyframes grow{from{transform:scaleX(0)}}
@keyframes growY{from{transform:scaleY(0)}}
@keyframes reveal{from{clip-path:inset(0 100% 0 0)}to{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0)}}
@keyframes shimmer{from{background-position:0% 0}to{background-position:-200% 0}}
@keyframes tiltY{from{transform:perspective(1600px) translateX(90px) rotateY(-18deg)}}
@keyframes tiltX{from{transform:perspective(1800px) translateY(90px) rotateX(24deg)}}
@keyframes rise3d{from{transform:perspective(2200px) translateY(300px) rotateX(46deg) scale(.82)}}
@keyframes popIn{from{transform:scale(.7)}}
@keyframes slideIn{from{transform:translateX(90px)}}
@keyframes blink{0%,49%{opacity:1}50%,100%{opacity:0}}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@keyframes gone{to{opacity:0;transform:scale(.6)}}
@keyframes type{from{max-width:0}}
@keyframes dots{0%,60%,100%{transform:translateY(0);opacity:.4}30%{transform:translateY(-8px);opacity:1}}
.r{animation:lift .9s var(--move,var(--spring)) both,clear .6s var(--out) both}
.f{animation:fadein .7s var(--out) both}
.p{animation:popIn .8s var(--spring) both,clear .4s var(--out) both}
.ty{animation:tiltY 1.1s var(--spring) both,clear .6s var(--out) both}
.tx{animation:tiltX 1.1s var(--spring) both,clear .6s var(--out) both}
.r3{transform-origin:50% 100%;animation:rise3d 1.4s var(--spring) both,clear .7s var(--out) both}
.w{animation:reveal .7s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1) both}
.typed{display:inline-block;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;vertical-align:bottom;max-width:1500px;animation:type 1.4s steps(36,end) both}
.caret{display:inline-block;width:4px;height:1.05em;margin-left:4px;vertical-align:-3px;background:{{secondary}};animation:blink 1s steps(1) infinite}
.grad{background:linear-gradient(90deg,{{primary}},{{secondary}},{{primary}});background-size:200% 100%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.eyebrow{font-weight:600;font-size:26px;letter-spacing:.32em;color:#9aa4c0}
.mono{font-family:'JetBrains Mono','DejaVu Sans Mono',Consolas,monospace}

.t-midnight{--ink:#fff;--muted:#a8b2cc;--dim:#7d87a3;--surface:#0f1424;--surface2:#151b2e;--border:1px solid #ffffff1c;--r:24px;--rs:14px;--shadow:0 50px 140px #0009;--glow:0 0 120px color-mix(in srgb,{{primary}} 24%,transparent);
  --display:Inter,sans-serif;--body:Inter,sans-serif;--dw:800;--dt:-.025em;--ds:1;--in-x:0px;--in-y:56px;--move:var(--spring);--on-p:#fff;--solid:#fff;--on-solid:#0a0d18;--shade:#05070dcc}
.t-paper{--ink:#16130f;--muted:#5c554b;--dim:#8a8276;--surface:#fffdf8;--surface2:#f3ede2;--border:2px solid #16130f;--r:6px;--rs:4px;--shadow:10px 10px 0 #16130f;--glow:0 0 0 transparent;
  --display:'Instrument Serif',Georgia,serif;--body:Inter,sans-serif;--dw:400;--dt:-.01em;--ds:1.18;--in-x:-80px;--in-y:0px;--move:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);--on-p:#fff;--solid:#16130f;--on-solid:#fffdf8;--shade:#f3ede2d9}
.t-terminal{--ink:#d9ffd0;--muted:#86b47f;--dim:#55804f;--surface:#050805;--surface2:#0b130b;--border:1px solid #2c4d2c;--r:2px;--rs:2px;--shadow:0 0 0 1px #1d331d;--glow:0 0 80px color-mix(in srgb,{{secondary}} 16%,transparent);
  --display:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;--body:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;--dw:700;--dt:-.05em;--ds:.9;--in-x:0px;--in-y:24px;--move:steps(4,end);--on-p:#031003;--solid:{{secondary}};--on-solid:#031003;--shade:#000000d9}
.t-pop{--ink:#111;--muted:#2c2c2c;--dim:#555;--surface:#fff;--surface2:#fff5d9;--border:4px solid #111;--r:28px;--rs:18px;--shadow:12px 12px 0 #111;--glow:0 0 0 transparent;
  --display:'Bricolage Grotesque',sans-serif;--body:'Bricolage Grotesque',sans-serif;--dw:800;--dt:-.045em;--ds:1.05;--in-x:0px;--in-y:140px;--move:var(--bounce);--on-p:#fff;--solid:#111;--on-solid:#fff;--shade:#ffffffb3}
.root{color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--body)}
.disp{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:var(--dw);letter-spacing:var(--dt)}
.t-paper .disp{font-style:normal}
.t-paper .grad{background:none;-webkit-background-clip:border-box;background-clip:border-box;color:{{primary}};font-style:italic}
.t-terminal .grad{background:none;-webkit-background-clip:border-box;background-clip:border-box;color:{{secondary}};text-shadow:0 0 18px color-mix(in srgb,{{secondary}} 70%,transparent)}
.t-terminal .grad::before{content:'> '}
.t-pop .grad{background:{{secondary}};-webkit-background-clip:border-box;background-clip:border-box;color:#111;padding:0 .14em;-webkit-box-decoration-break:clone;box-decoration-break:clone}
.t-paper .eyebrow,.t-terminal .eyebrow,.t-pop .eyebrow{color:var(--muted)}
/* exits and camera, per theme */
@keyframes leaveL{to{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-70px)}}
@keyframes leaveCut{0%,99%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0}}
@keyframes leaveDrop{to{opacity:0;transform:translateY(80px) scale(.96)}}
@keyframes pan{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-36px)}}
@keyframes flick{0%{opacity:0}20%{opacity:1}35%{opacity:.25}55%{opacity:1}70%{opacity:.6}100%{opacity:1}}
.t-paper .x{animation-name:leaveL}
.t-terminal .x{animation-name:leaveCut}
.t-pop .x{animation-name:leaveDrop}
.t-paper .cam{animation-name:pan}
.t-terminal .cam{animation-name:none}
.t-terminal .r,.t-terminal .p,.t-terminal .ty,.t-terminal .tx,.t-terminal .r3{animation:lift .4s steps(4,end) both,flick .5s steps(5,end) both}
.t-paper .ty,.t-paper .tx,.t-paper .r3{animation:lift .9s var(--move) both,clear .5s var(--out) both}

.cur{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;z-index:50;animation:cur var(--T) linear both}
.cur .pt{width:44px;height:56px;transform-origin:6px 4px;animation:press var(--T) linear both;filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 10px #0005)}
.cur .rp{position:absolute;left:-26px;top:-26px;width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid {{secondary}};animation:ripple .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both,fadein .01s step-end both}
@keyframes ripple{from{transform:scale(.2);opacity:1}to{transform:scale(1.6);opacity:0}}
@property --n{syntax:'<integer>';inherits:false;initial-value:0}
@keyframes count{from{--n:0}to{--n:var(--to)}}
.num{counter-reset:n var(--n);animation:count 1.4s var(--out) both}.num::after{content:counter(n)}
/* hook */
.hk{position:absolute;left:0;width:3200px;top:200px;text-align:center}
.badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px 26px;border-radius:999px;background:color-mix(in srgb,{{primary}} 20%,var(--surface));border:var(--border);font-size:28px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);animation:dropIn .7s var(--spring) both,fadein .3s ease-out both}
@keyframes dropIn{from{transform:translateY(-120px)}}
.badge i{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:{{secondary}};box-shadow:0 0 0 0 {{secondary}};animation:beat 1.2s ease-out infinite}
@keyframes beat{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 color-mix(in srgb,{{secondary}} 70%,transparent)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 16px transparent}}
.ft{margin-top:26px;font-size:calc(124px * var(--ds));line-height:1.04;position:relative;display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;animation:focusIn .9s var(--out) both}
@keyframes focusIn{from{transform:scale(.88);opacity:0;filter:blur(16px)}}
.sheen{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(105deg,transparent 35%,color-mix(in srgb,#fff 55%,transparent) 50%,transparent 65%);mix-blend-mode:overlay;animation:sweep 1.1s ease-in-out both}
@keyframes sweep{from{transform:translateX(-100%)}to{transform:translateX(100%)}}
/* before / after panel */
.pn{position:absolute;left:900px;top:560px;width:1400px;height:820px;border-radius:var(--r);overflow:hidden;border:var(--border);box-shadow:var(--shadow),var(--glow);animation:lift .9s var(--move) both,clear .5s var(--out) both}
.bf,.af{position:absolute;inset:0}
.bf{background:var(--surface2);padding:56px 64px}
.bt{font-size:26px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}
.sl{margin-top:24px;width:720px}
.s{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;height:74px;padding:0 22px;margin-bottom:12px;border-radius:var(--rs);background:var(--surface);border:var(--border);font-size:26px;color:var(--muted);animation:slideIn .55s var(--spring) both,clear .35s var(--out) both}
.s b{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:8px;border:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 25%,transparent);flex:none}
.tm{position:absolute;right:80px;top:260px;text-align:right}
.tm .v{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:var(--dw);font-size:calc(170px * var(--ds));line-height:1;color:var(--muted);display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:flex-end}
.tm .v u{text-decoration:none;font-size:.32em;margin-left:10px}
.tm .l{margin-top:8px;font-size:26px;color:var(--dim)}
@keyframes tick{0%,100%{transform:rotate(-6deg)}50%{transform:rotate(6deg)}}
.clock{display:inline-block;width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;border:5px solid var(--dim);position:relative;margin-bottom:18px;animation:tick .5s steps(2) infinite}
.clock::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:50%;top:8px;width:5px;height:18px;margin-left:-2.5px;background:var(--dim);border-radius:3px}
.af{background:var(--surface);animation:wipe 1.2s linear both}
@keyframes wipe{0%{clip-path:inset(0 1330px 0 0);animation-timing-function:cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1)}75%{clip-path:inset(0 70px 0 0);animation-timing-function:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}100%{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0)}}
.at{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:110px;text-align:center;font-size:calc(70px * var(--ds));color:var(--ink)}
.chip{position:absolute;left:50%;top:225px;transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;padding:10px 24px;border-radius:999px;background:color-mix(in srgb,{{secondary}} 22%,transparent);font-size:28px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink)}
.chip u{text-decoration:none;font-weight:600}
.btn{position:absolute;left:440px;top:415px;width:520px;height:110px;border-radius:999px;background:{{primary}};color:var(--on-p);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:38px;font-weight:800;box-shadow:0 20px 50px color-mix(in srgb,{{primary}} 45%,transparent);overflow:hidden;animation:fadeout .25s ease-in both}
@keyframes hover{to{transform:scale(1.04)}}
.btn .lb{animation:fadeout .15s linear both}
.btn .pg{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:100%;background:color-mix(in srgb,#fff 30%,transparent);transform-origin:left;animation:grow .9s cubic-bezier(.45,0,.55,1) both,fadein .01s step-end both}
.res{position:absolute;left:330px;right:330px;top:360px}
.rw{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;height:74px;padding:0 22px;margin-bottom:14px;border-radius:var(--rs);background:var(--surface2);border:var(--border);font-size:26px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);animation:popIn .55s var(--bounce) both,clear .3s var(--out) both}
.rw b{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:{{secondary}};color:#111;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:18px;flex:none}
.rw i{margin-left:auto;width:90px;height:52px;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,{{primary}},{{secondary}})}
.hdl{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:0;width:0;animation:hand 1.2s linear both}
@keyframes hand{0%{transform:translateX(70px);opacity:1;animation-timing-function:cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1)}75%{transform:translateX(1330px);opacity:1}100%{transform:translateX(1330px);opacity:0}}
.hdl::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:-2px;top:0;bottom:0;width:4px;background:{{secondary}};box-shadow:0 0 20px {{secondary}}}
.hdl b{position:absolute;left:-36px;top:376px;width:72px;height:72px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--surface);border:4px solid {{secondary}};display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:26px;font-weight:900;color:var(--ink);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
/* keycaps */
.keys{position:absolute;left:2400px;top:820px;display:flex;gap:20px}
.key{width:150px;height:150px;border-radius:30px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 30%,#000);padding:0 0 12px;animation:lift .7s var(--spring) both,clear .4s var(--out) both}
.kc{width:150px;height:138px;border-radius:30px;background:var(--surface);border:var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:var(--dw);font-size:62px;color:var(--ink);box-shadow:inset 0 -6px 0 color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 12%,transparent)}
@keyframes keyDown{0%{transform:translateY(0)}20%,70%{transform:translateY(10px);background:color-mix(in srgb,{{primary}} 25%,var(--surface))}100%{transform:translateY(0)}}
.kc.dn{animation:keyDown .55s ease-out both}
/* command palette */
.pal{position:absolute;left:1050px;top:640px;width:1100px;z-index:20;animation:drop .5s var(--spring) both,fadein .2s ease-out both}
@keyframes drop{from{transform:translateY(-60px) scale(.96)}}
.pal>div{border-radius:var(--r);background:var(--surface);border:var(--border);box-shadow:0 60px 140px #0008,var(--shadow);overflow:hidden;animation:fadeout .25s ease-in both}
.q{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;height:96px;padding:0 34px;border-bottom:var(--border);font-size:34px;color:var(--ink)}
.q .k{font-size:22px;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:8px;border:var(--border);color:var(--dim)}
.q .typed{animation-duration:.7s}
.pr{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;height:76px;margin:10px 14px;padding:0 22px;border-radius:var(--rs);font-size:28px;color:var(--muted)}
.pr i{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:8px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 18%,transparent)}
@keyframes pick{0%{background:transparent;color:var(--muted)}100%{background:color-mix(in srgb,{{primary}} 22%,transparent);color:var(--ink)}}
.pr.p{animation:pick .25s ease-out both}.pr.p i{background:{{primary}}}
.toast{position:absolute;left:1860px;top:450px;z-index:30;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:20px 30px;border-radius:var(--rs);background:var(--solid);color:var(--on-solid);font-size:30px;font-weight:800;box-shadow:var(--shadow);animation:popIn .55s var(--bounce) both,clear .3s var(--out) both}
.toast b{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:{{secondary}};color:#111;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:18px}
/* the feature page: benefits + availability */
.bn{position:absolute;left:900px;top:1480px;width:1400px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:40px}
.bx{padding:34px;border-radius:var(--r);background:var(--surface);border:var(--border);box-shadow:var(--shadow);animation:lift .7s var(--move) both,clear .4s var(--out) both}
.bx i{display:block;width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,{{primary}},{{secondary}});margin-bottom:22px}
.bx .h{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:var(--dw);font-size:calc(36px * var(--ds));color:var(--ink)}
